use_case: Detect commuter rail line alert-based disruptions where multiple high-impact advisories are active with corroborating telemetry.

incidents.note: Fitchburg Line to Wachusett: 2 alerts, detected by live triage as disruption during Sunday evening service.
Lowell Line to North Billerica: 2 alerts detected as disruption.
Lowell Line to North Station: inbound direction, same alert-based disruption.
